lines: When people decide something, they vote.
Meerkats hunt for food in a group.
The meerkats can make a special sound.
That means, "Let's hunt in a different place."
Sometimes, more than three meerkats make this sound.
Then, the group decides to move to another place.
Sometimes, honeybees need a bigger hive.
They look for a new place to build it.
After a bee finds a new place, it comes back and dances.
That means, "I know a good place for a new hive."
Then, other bees visit the place.
If they like it, they come back and dance, too.
Then, all the bees decide to build their home there.
body.text: When people decide something, they vote. Some animals vote, too. They vote in different ways. Meerkats hunt for food in a group. The meerkats can make a special sound. That means, "Let's hunt in a different place." Sometimes, more than three meerkats make this sound. Then, the group decides to move to another place. Sometimes, honeybees need a bigger hive. They look for a new place to build it. After a bee finds a new place, it comes back and dances. That means, "I know a good place for a new hive." Then, other bees visit the place. If they like it, they come back and dance, too. Then, all the bees decide to build their home there.
